facts.fact: INTIC, Mozambique's national ICT institute, opened a one-month public consultation on the first version of the draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, running until 4 June 2026, seeking contributions from public and private institutions, academia, development partners and citizens, and held provincial consultation sessions with public sector, private sector, civil society and academia representatives.

systems.country_label: commission established by decree to assess the final AI strategy before government submission; no opinion yet stated

systems.system: Multisectoral Working Group on the AI strategy
systems.country_label: working group convened by the Minister to review the strategy; no outside membership stated
